summary: Cebu 6th District representative with 31 principal-authored bills. Only a new regional trial court branch surfaced; no rubric-topic bills. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
